Customize Temp 12k Regional Composites Parameters




To create a Temperature 12k Composites reconstruction, adjust the options below and click "submit." You will recieve an email when your reconstruction is done.

For more information about each of the options, mouse over the question mark icons or see Kaufman et al. 2020 for more details. Default values will produce a reconstruction similar to the one in Kaufman et al., 2020. If you are unsure what an option does, leaving it at its default value is a good choice.








? define a start and end year in units years BP
